purpose: Transparent logo cutouts for dashboard My products.

assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: small dashboard product icon. The reference image is a six-cell contact sheet of existing logos. Produce ONLY ONE isolated cutout from the bottom-left cell labeled cs2.png: the central white CS2 wordmark and small player silhouette in that wordmark. Remove the large background soldier, architecture, sky and ground. Ignore all other cells and exclude filename labels. Preserve the logo's original design, colors, proportions and exact lettering. Do not redesign or add anything. Output a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG, with alpha 0 around the logo and through its negative spaces; no white/black canvas, no painted checkerboard, no tile, frame, scenery or cast shadow. Center the extracted logo, tightly framed with only 4% transparent padding. Clean crisp edges readable at 40px.
